_comment: web_clipper_diff assertions reference fixtures/expected/*-expected.md, which are placeholders pending real Obsidian Web Clipper output — see fixtures/expected/README.md. Do not mark those assertions as run until the corresponding expected file is real.

test_cases.prompt: clip this article for me https://example.com/some-post
test_cases.expected_output: Fetches the URL, climbs the extraction ladder for author/published/description, writes a frozen Resource file with type: article in frontmatter, reports the file path.

Fetches the URL, resolves author/published/publisher via the extraction ladder, writes a frozen Resource file with type: news and a publisher field in frontmatter, body as verbatim {{content}} per the News template's bare-variable body.

test_cases.prompt: clip this thread for me https://x.com/someuser/status/123456789
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL as a Social/Forum thread, writes a frozen Resource file with type: social, bare root_post plus the author's own continuation replies (not other participants' replies), author as display name falling back to handle.
test_cases._no_web_clipper_diff: Real Obsidian Web Clipper has no concept matching continuation (author's own reply-chain) — only single-post text extraction, no schema.org on X/Twitter. No fair comparison possible; verified by mechanical assertions only.

test_cases.expected_output: Pulls the transcript via youtube-transcript-api (not the extraction ladder), writes a frozen Resource file with type: video, bare transcript, author as the channel name.

test_cases.prompt: clip https://reddit.com/r/somewhere/comments/xyz, I think it's an article
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL is a Reddit thread, notices the conflict with the user's stated type, flags it before writing rather than silently picking either side.

test_cases.prompt: clip this youtube video: https://youtube.com/watch?v=abc123, it has no captions at all
test_cases.expected_output: Attempts youtube-transcript-api, gets NoTranscriptFound or TranscriptsDisabled, reports a clean failure and writes nothing — does not attempt any workaround.

test_cases.prompt: clip this article for me https://example.com/some-post
test_cases.expected_output: Stops before fetching anything, tells the user to run setup-slipbox first, and does not write any file or improvise conventions in config.json's absence — regardless of whether the vault has no .slipbox/ at all, has one with no config.json yet, or has an interrupted/partial setup. clip-resource only ever checks for config.json's presence, so all three states are equivalent from its point of view.
